meta.title: Forge Chips
meta.description: Commit, push and create or view PRs from compact composer chips. Git runs on the host and an auxiliary model writes commit messages.

error: Could not run the Git action. Check the session before retrying.
errorUnavailable: The session is busy or has no branch checked out. Try again when it is idle.
errorNothingToCommit: There are no changes to commit.
errorMessageFailed: Could not write a commit message. Check the commit message model settings.
errorCommitFailed: Git could not create the commit. Check commit hooks and your Git identity.
errorNoRemote: This branch has no remote to push to.
errorPushFailed: The commit was created, but the push failed. Check the remote and your credentials.
errorNotPushed: Push this branch before creating a PR.
errorUnsupported: Creating a PR is not supported for this code host.
errorPrFailed: Could not create the PR. Check that the code host CLI is signed in.
lookupError: Git status is unavailable. Select View PR to check.
integrationHint: Bring this worktree's commits into the current branch of the original checkout
blockedReadOnly: This session is read-only, so it cannot commit in the original checkout.
blockedDetached: The original checkout has no branch checked out.
blockedInProgress: A Git operation is in progress in the original checkout.
blockedStaged: The original checkout has staged changes.
blockedOverlap: Uncommitted changes in the original checkout overlap: {paths}
integrationStale: The checkouts changed, so the proposal was refreshed. Check it and try again.
integrationBusy: Another integration or a turn is running. Try again when it finishes.
integrationFailed: Integration failed and was rolled back. The original checkout is unchanged.
integrationCleanupRefused: Integration stopped. Its Git state was left as-is because it may belong to another operation; check the original checkout.
integrationError: Could not integrate. Check the original checkout and try again.
